subject: Compliance re-attestation: audit log horizon and renewal commitments
messages:
From: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@novusdata.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — retention horizon request

Hi Karthik,

We're beginning our vendor recertification ahead of contract renewal and have a couple of asks that will affect our renewal decision (and potential seat/throughput increase). Key points: 

- Regulator needs a 5-year audit log retention window for certain datasets — current contract references 13 months. Can Redwood extend retention to 5 years for our account and what is the estimated delta in fees?
- We'll need SOC 2 re-attestation documentation covering the past 12 months (report + supporting evidence manifest). Can you confirm what evidence Red­wood can make available and the secure transfer mechanism?
- We're also budgeting to add +50 seats and request burst capacity for peak month. Can you include sizing/price guidance tied to a renewal amendment?

I've attached our vendor questionnaire and a sample manifest of records we'd like included. Please loop in whoever owns evidence transfer and pricing. 

Thanks,
Sofia Delgado
Senior IT Compliance Manager
Novus Data
Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire_Novus_2026.xlsx, audit_evidence_manifest.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@novusdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — retention horizon request

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear summary and the questionnaire. Quick responses and a proposed next step: 

1) Retention window: We can support a custom retention window up to 7 years via a contract amendment; 5 years is feasible but will have a per-GiB/month delta (driven by storage tiering + egress SLA). I will work with pricing to surface a delta and a revised exhibit for the renewal.

2) SOC 2 evidence: Redwood can provide the SOC 2 report (redacted where necessary) plus a scoped evidence bundle (system configs, change logs, access logs) aggregated for the last 12 months. For large manifests we'll use a short-lived encrypted S3 bucket or secure transfer portal — Lauren, can you own the evidence instructions and transfer window?

3) Seats & capacity: Marcus, can you propose an uplift plan (50 seats + monthly burst) and a rough quote tied to a 12–24 month commit? Sofia — do you have a preferred procurement timeline (PO, signature) or must this align to a fiscal quarter?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on timelines and deliverables. I can also prepare a single renewal amendment draft that covers retention, seat expansion, and pricing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-650-555-1212

Hi all — looping in the Customer Success / Compliance ops playbook steps. Short version and attachments.

What Redwood can deliver:
- SOC 2 report (Q2 2026) in PDF form, plus a mapped evidence manifest describing artifact locations and redaction notes (SOC2_report_Q2_2026.pdf, audit_evidence_manifest.csv).
- For retention changes: we will add a Retention Exhibit to the Master Services Agreement that defines the data classes, retention horizon (5 years), and associated costs. That exhibit will include controls around access, export, and deletion.
- Secure transfer: we will provision an S3 staging location with client-side encryption and a time-limited token. We'll also provide step-by-step evidence upload/download instructions (see attached evidence-instructions.pdf).

Pricing delta (ballpark): 5-year retention + cold storage tier — ~0.08 USD/GiB/month over current baseline. Exact delta depends on the retentionable dataset size we see in your manifest; we'll quote formally once Marcus has sizing.

Deliverables & timeline proposal: 
- By EOD Aug 28: Redwood to share SOC 2 report + evidence manifest (read-only copy) and provisional retention exhibit draft.
- Aug 30–Sep 03: Evidence transfer window for Novus to review artifact samples (we'll keep transfer encrypted and auditable).
- Sep 06: Revised quote and DocuSign-ready amendment (retention + seat increase + burst).

I've attached the evidence instructions and a sample manifest export for your legal/compliance review.

Attachments: evidence-instructions.pdf

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Lauren.Bishop@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0199
From: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@novusdata.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — retention horizon request

Thanks — this sounds good and aligns with our internal timeline. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We'll target Sep 15 signature, so the Sep 06 quote + DocuSign window works. Please include a one-time migration credit if Redwood can absorb the data migration effort to the cold tier — that will help us finalize the internal ask.
- Our legal contact (cc'd) prefers the retention exhibit to reference specific data classes instead of blanket account-level language; we'll mark those in the questionnaire.
- For sizing: Marcus, you can treat the manifest as indicative; we will prioritize a subset of event logs (~2.4 TiB) for immediate retention change, then evaluate expanding to full set next quarter.

Please send the SOC 2 report and the secure transfer link when ready. If you can get the evidence staging by Aug 28 as Lauren proposed, we'll start internal validation.

Best,
Sofia Delgado
Senior IT Compliance Manager
Novus Data
